$comment: Design-system drift budget — a RATCHET, not a pass/fail rule.
WHY A RATCHET INSTEAD OF A LINT RULE
oxlint (this repo's linter) has no custom-rule plugin API, so these cannot be
written as lint rules. More importantly, a binary rule would be wrong here even if
it were possible: 365 arbitrary px values cannot be fixed in one commit, so a
pass/fail rule would have to be disabled on day one and would then never come back.
A ratchet cannot be disabled — it only ever allows the number to go DOWN.
Counts below are the real measured state of `main` at the start of the UI
implementation plan (2026-08-03). When a phase reduces a count, run
`bun run design:guard --update` and commit the new budget WITH that phase's work.
Never raise a number to make CI pass — that is the one edit this file exists to
Marketing files are counted even though marketing is out of scope for the current
plan. Fixing them is deferred; REGRESSING them is still blocked.

rawButton.why: Raw <button> bypasses ui/button: loses focus-visible ring, disabled semantics, size scale and the Phase A no-greyed-primary invariant. Audit §C.

rawSelect.why: A native <select> paints the OPERATING SYSTEM accent colour into its open dropdown. No amount of chroma:0 in the stylesheet overrides it. This is a hard blocker for the monochrome mandate, not a style preference. Audit §D step 6.

arbitraryPx.why: 365 one-off [Npx] values instead of a scale. Top offenders [10px]x70, [11px]x43, [15px]x33, [14px]x29. NOTE [1100px]x20 is a CONTAINER WIDTH and needs a --container-* token, not a spacing-scale entry — do not let a regex flatten that distinction.

rawHex.why: Raw hex in TSX cannot respond to light/dark or to the monochrome migration. Concentrated in WaitlistForm.tsx, EnterpriseDialog.tsx, contact.tsx. Includes #22C55E x16.

cardLift.why: Third overlapping card treatment alongside .card-weeber and .card-action. Collapses into ui/card variant='interactive'.

cardAction.why: Second overlapping card treatment. Same collapse as cardLift.

transitionAll.why: transition-all animates layout-affecting properties and forces reflow. Name the properties, and animate transform/opacity where possible.

inlineCardClone.why: Files hand-rolling a card as rounded-*+border+bg-* instead of using the card primitive. Count is FILES, not occurrences. Was recorded as 50 because the original ripgrep call passed `-g '!components/ui/**'` — a glob containing a slash is anchored to the search root, so ripgrep silently never applied it and counted dialog/input/select/textarea.tsx as clones of a card. Ratcheted DOWN to the real excluded count when the counter stopped shelling out to rg. rawButton/rawSelect were unaffected: components/ui/ contains zero `<button`/`<select` matches either way.
